name: Custom Shape Engraved 1-Layer Mirror Acrylic Ornament
description:
KEY FEATURES

  • Premium Material:
    - Made from high-quality 1-layer mirror acrylic with a smooth, reflective finish.
    - Crafted with 3 mm thickness for a lightweight yet sturdy feel.
    - Available in 2 mirror finishes: Gold Mirror Acrylic and Silver Mirror Acrylic.
    - Includes hanging accessories for easy display.
    - Features a sleek, polished look that adds an elegant touch to holiday décor.
     
  • Sizes & Dimensions:
    - Available in sizes:
               +) 3.54 × 3.54 in ~ 9 × 9 cm
               +) 4 × 4 in ~ 10.16 × 10.16 cm
               +) 5 × 5 in ~ 12.7 × 12.7 cm
               +) 6 × 6 in ~ 15.24 × 15.24 cm
    📌 Note: The dimensions of the product may vary slightly depending on the design, as sizes are not fixed.
     
  • Engraving Technology:
    - Supports custom engraved designs on mirror acrylic.
    - Available in 2 design styles:
               +) Cut Out
               +) Engrave
    - Custom shape design makes each ornament more unique and eye-catching.
    - The front shows the personalized design clearly, while the back displays the reverse mirrored appearance.

 

  • Function & Usage:
    - Designed as a personalized hanging ornament for seasonal and special-occasion décor.
    - Easy to hang on Christmas trees, walls, doors, hooks, gift boxes, or decorative displays.
    - Lightweight construction makes it easy to use without weighing down branches.
    - Ideal for personalizing with names, dates, short messages, or meaningful designs.
    - Suitable for use as a keepsake ornament or a stylish decorative accent.
     
  • Perfect Gift for Any Occasion:
    - Perfect for Christmas, weddings, anniversaries, baby showers, and other celebrations.
    - A meaningful gift for couples, families, friends, and loved ones.
    - Great for commemorating special moments, milestones, and holiday memories.
    - Ideal as a personalized keepsake, stocking stuffer, or decorative gift.
    - A beautiful choice for anyone who loves custom ornaments with a modern mirror finish.

 

SPECIFICATION

  • Processing Time: 1-3 working days on average after payment and all designs updated correctly
  • Shipping Time: 6-9 working days average (US)
  • Packaging:1 x Custom Shape Engraved 1-Layer Mirror Acrylic Ornament

 

PRODUCTION

  • The tracking Country Origin is the US

guideLine:
Print Guidelines

Below is our complete selection of art templates used for designing within the full printable area of our products. Each template comes with a .png detailing Safe Area, Bleed, etc. 

  • Download templates and mockups here

 

To use an Art Template:

  • Open the Printway template for your selected product in Photoshop or another design program.
  • Insert your artwork in a new layer, placing all important parts of your design within the designated “Safe zone” on the art template to ensure your design will not be cut off during the printing process.
  • If you’re designing drinkware, use the indicated centering lines to ensure your artwork is placed exactly where you’d like.
  • Hide or delete the Art Template layer from your file.
  • Save as a .png, .jpg, or another accepted file type.
  • You’ve now used a Printway template to create artwork exactly to the recommended specs for that product.

 

To ensure your design prints properly on each product:

  • Ensure all important elements of your design are within the safe zone on the product template.
  • Fill the entire design template! The outer edge of the template represents “Bleed Area,” which signifies the areas which may print on the outer edges of your product.
  • Failure to fill the bleed area will likely result in unprinted white unprinted areas around the edge of your product.
